verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a workflow automation platform that stores execution data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention, pruning or deletion controls. Self-hosting, execution search, and a community note that n8n 'keeps all historical executions' are adjacent features, not user control over how long data is kept or when it is deleted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
